Founded in 1882, McNairn Packaging manufactures a broad range of food packaging products for the food service, supermarket, bakery and food processing markets, with an emphasis on creating innovative, value-added products that help our customers succeed. Our products are supplied to our end users through leading distributors of packaging and food service products across North America.

Engineered to address the concerns of bakers and consumers, McNairn Packaging offers EnviroBake®, an evolutionary premium release pan liner for the new age of bakers. What sets this product apart from the rest is that EnviroBake® does not contain any chromium compounds and is unbleached.

Wherever food is served, from the BBQ pit to the concession stand, at the ball park or fine dining restaurants, you can find McNairn Packaging products used in food preparation, serving and take-away packaging.
McNairn Packaging provides a wide selection of quality bags in various shapes and sizes, designed to keep today’s specialty breads fresher for longer.
